setup.input_units: native; encoder units are twice the detents

steps.caption: Channel 1 plays one trig on step 1: root C (MIDI 60, C3) at velocity 50, held for 4 steps. Chd1 to Chd4 on the Masks page are E, G, A and C (MIDI 64, 67, 69, 72) and the output is polyphonic. Trig params is open on its parameter list, showing Mute Chord Root. Chord Note Strum (1/2) and Chord Pattern (-> forward) are already assigned; Mute Chord Root is not.
steps.title: Starting point

steps.caption: Press K3 to assign Mute Chord Root and K2 to return, then turn E3 one detent to On. Turn E2 to the next slot, press K2 and turn E3 to Chord Velocity Mod.
steps.title: Switch Mute Chord Root On

steps.caption: Press K3 to assign Chord Velocity Mod and K2 to return, then turn E3 to +10. Tap Play (1,8), then tap it again to stop. The MIDI strip lists four notes, not five: the root C3 (60) is silent, but the chord notes keep their places, E3 (64) half a step in at velocity 60, G3 (67) at one step (70), A3 (69) at 1 1/2 steps (80) and C4 (72) at two steps (90). With Mute Chord Root at X, 60 would sound first at velocity 50.
